heading_en: Reflection of Hedging Effects of Internal Transactions
summary_ja: 内部取引によるヘッジ効果の反映に関する標準的手法の規定を、読替えの上で内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社に準用する。
summary_en: Applies the standardized-approach provisions on the hedging effects of internal transactions to Ultimate Designated Parent Companies adopting the internal ratings-based approach, with textual substitutions.
paragraphs: Article 99, Article 100, paragraph (2), Articles 101 through 104 and Articles 106 through 108 apply mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach. In this case, the phrase "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in these provisions shall be deemed to be replaced with "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", and the phrase "Article 46, paragraph (1)" in Article 99, paragraph (2) shall be deemed to be replaced with "Article 46, paragraph (1) as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 134, paragraph (7) or Article 142, paragraph (5)".
